# MarkaUI — full reference for LLMs

> MarkaUI is a premium, MIT-licensed design system for React. 221 components grouped into
> 58 documentation families, reachable by 339+ names via an alias-aware registry. 12 colour
> themes, each with a complete light and dark token set, built on Radix UI primitives and
> styled with Tailwind CSS v4 utility classes plus CSS custom-property design tokens.
> TypeScript-first, ESM + CJS, framework-agnostic (Next.js App Router, Vite, Remix, or
> plain React). Includes a full production demo application built from the library's own
> components.
>
> COMPONENT COUNT: "339+" is computed, not hand-written — 221 components + 118 alias names
> (`src/components/showcase/registry/index.ts`, `TOTAL_COMPONENTS` = `expandAliases(allDocs).length`).
> The component index below lists the 221 real components; aliases resolve to their real doc.

- Canonical site: https://markaui.vercel.app
- npm package: `markaui` (current published version 1.0.1)
- Source: https://github.com/markaui/markaui
- License: MIT
- Peer dependencies: `react` >= 18, `react-dom` >= 18

---

## Installation

    npm install markaui

Global stylesheet:

    @import "tailwindcss";
    @import "markaui/theme.css";
    @import "tw-animate-css";

Then wrap the app:

    import { MarkaUIProvider } from "markaui";

    <MarkaUIProvider defaultTheme="maroon" defaultMode="light">
      {children}
    </MarkaUIProvider>

### Troubleshooting: components render unstyled

Occurs when the consumer's Tailwind build predates the `@source` mechanism (markaui <= 1.0.0)
or overrides it. Fix by registering the bundle manually, after the imports:

    @source "../node_modules/markaui/dist";

The path is relative to the CSS file; adjust the `../` depth accordingly.

---

## Theming model

`MarkaUIProvider` sets `data-theme="<id>"` on `<html>` and toggles the `dark` class. The
provider is not required — setting the attributes directly works:

    <html data-theme="royal" class="dark">

`theme.css` declares `@custom-variant dark (&:is(.dark *))`, so `dark:` utilities follow the
`dark` class rather than the operating-system preference.

The `useMarkaUI()` hook returns `{ theme, setTheme, mode, toggleMode, themes }`.

### Theme ids

| id | Name | Group |
|---|---|---|
| `maroon` | Maroon & Gold | Signature |
| `wine` | Burgundy & Honey | Signature |
| `rose` | Rose Gold | Signature |
| `royal` | Royal Purple | Signature |
| `emerald` | Emerald & Brass | Heritage |
| `forest` | Forest & Sage | Heritage |
| `teal` | Teal & Copper | Heritage |
| `champagne` | Champagne Bronze | Heritage |
| `cocoa` | Cocoa & Caramel | Heritage |
| `coral` | Coral Terracotta | Modern |
| `plum` | Plum & Mauve | Modern |
| `noir` | Noir & Silver | Modern |

24 combinations (12 palettes x light/dark), each tuned for WCAG-AA contrast.

### Avoiding a flash of the wrong theme

Server output uses the default theme; the client reads `localStorage` and repaints. Add an
inline script in `<head>` that sets the attributes before first paint:

    <script>
      (function () {
        var t = localStorage.getItem("markaui-theme");
        var m = localStorage.getItem("markaui-mode");
        if (t) document.documentElement.setAttribute("data-theme", t);
        if (m === "dark") document.documentElement.classList.add("dark");
      })();
    </script>

Also set `suppressHydrationWarning` on `<html>`.

## Bundling notes

The package is a tree-shakeable ESM bundle; named imports pull only what is used:

    import { Button } from "markaui";
    import { Dialog, DialogContent, DialogTrigger } from "markaui";

Deep-path imports (`markaui/dist/...`) are not part of the public API — always import from the
package root. Two components, `Link` and `Media`, depend on `next/link` and `next/image` and
are therefore not re-exported from the root barrel; copy them from the source app if
Next-optimised routing or images are needed.
